dedupe_keys.name: opendata comune fi it public transport datasets

description: opendata.comune.fi.it: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opendata.comune.fi.it. Coverage: the area served by opendata.comune.fi.it. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: PS - MAPPA 9 - FERMATE DEL SERVIZIO TRAMVIARIO; PS - MAPPA 9 - LINEA TRAMVIARIA; PS - MAPPA 14 - LINEA TRAMVIARIA; PS - MAPPA 10 - LINEA TRAMVIARIA. Formats seen: ZIP, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
